messages:
vikram: Quick sync: partner QA flagged mismatch between our marketplace image driver and a customer's custom ROM. Need decision: pin to vendor-specified driver or provide hotfix path?

claire_m: Details? Which driver & CUDA/ROCm combination is failing?

hao: Failure repros on Ampere nodes with kernel 5.15 + driver 535.72. CUDA tests show nvml init errors intermittently. Our staging used 535.86 + CUDA 12.2.1 which passed.

vikram: Partner says their managed HW uses 535.72 and can't upgrade kernel easily. They asked for a signed hotpatch we can supply.

claire_m: Two options: 1) create a compat image pinned to 535.72/CUDA 12.2.0 and publish as "compat-legacy", or 2) craft a targeted hotpatch (driver blob + install script) that their SI can apply. Both need QA and signing.

hao: Hotpatch is smaller footprint but riskier on airgapped installs; need rollback instructions. Compat image increases storage/maintenance.

eng-release-bot: Release check triggered: verify-image-tag(compat-legacy-535.72) and sign-off-checklist incomplete: security-signature missing, SI-bundle manifest missing.

ops: Can build the compat image fast if we have the exact driver binary. Where will we host signed artifacts for partners (airgapped vs cloud)?

partner-nre: From partner side: hotpatch bundle preferred, fewer approvals in our infra. Must be GPG-signed and include sha256 checksums. Also provide a brief runbook for rollback steps.

vikram: Ok let's split work: 
- Hao + ops: make a minimal hotpatch bundle draft and smoke test on one Ampere node.
- Claire: draft compat-image plan as contingency (storage/retention policy).
- Eng-release-bot / security: arrange artifact signing key (who signs?).
- Legal_s: partner bulletin wording and liability note for hotpatches.

legal_s: We'll need an acknowledgement clause in the partner bulletin: third-party kernel changes + driver patches are "provided as-is" and partner must accept rollback SLA. Draft incoming.

eng-release-bot: Hotpatch CI job queued: hotpatch-smoke/1777777777. Tests: driver load/unload, nvml init, perf sanity. ETA 22m.

hao: Pushing initial hotpatch tarball to staging: gs://redwood-staging/hotpatches/1777777777/hotpatch.tar.gz (contains install.sh, modules/, manifest.sha256, README.md).

ops: Pulled tarball and ran smoke on Ampere test rack: driver loads, nvml init ok, inference smoke passes. No kernel oops. Logs: gs://redwood-staging/logs/hotpatch-1777777777.txt

claire_m: Good. I'll start the compat-image build doc: retention 30 days for staging tags, 90 days for GA. If we go this route, we should tag images with the partner id so we can prune later.

vikram: Partner NRE: can you do a quick validation on your infra with the hotpatch bundle? We'll need confirmation before signing.

partner-nre: We'll try tonight and report back by 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Need a signed bundle though.

eng-release-bot: Requesting signer: security@redwood to sign hotpatch.tar.gz. Please confirm key fingerprint.

ops: For airgapped delivery we'll provide the tarball plus GPG sig and a small wrapper to verify checksum and signature before install. Also include uninstall helper.

legal_s: Draft partner bulletin attached in #partners-briefing (private). It includes rollback terms and support SLA: Redwood provides guidance, partner responsible for kernel-level changes; critical regressions will be triaged with vendor; target response 72h.

hao: One more note: we found a flaky nvlink timeout on one node. Added heuristic to install.sh to detect nvlink logs and skip hotpatch if nvlink is degraded; recommend opening an ops ticket instead of applying patch.

vikram: Decision path: if partner infra can accept hotpatch and signs the acceptance, we ship signed hotpatch + runbook. If not, offer compat-legacy image as paid/opt-in offering.

ops: I'll hold image build until partner confirms. If they opt for compat-image, I'll queue builds and add routing label "partner-1777".

eng-release-bot: Hotpatch CI passed: 8/8. Artifacts staged and awaiting security signature.

partner-nre: Confirmed hotpatch validated on their staging infra: driver loads, no nvml errors. Requesting signed artifact for production deploy.

vikram: Security, please sign hotpatch.tar.gz and post signature here. Also attach fingerprint and verification steps.

eng-release-bot: Signature posted: hotpatch.tar.gz.asc, signer fingerprint: AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 AB12 CD34 EF56 7890 AB12 CD34. Verification steps in README.

hao: I'll update install.sh to include explicit gpg --verify and sha256sum checks and then repackage. New tarball path: gs://redwood-staging/hotpatches/1777777777/hotpatch-signed.tar.gz

ops: Packaging complete. For marketplace compatibility notes: we'll add an FAQ entry outlining the hotpatch option vs compat image and the expected lifecycle.

vikram: Summary/action items:
- ops: deliver signed bundle to partner production and provide airgap packaging (owner)
- hao: add signature verification + nvlink heuristic to install.sh (owner)
- claire_m: finalize compat-image contingency doc and retention policy (owner)
- legal_s: finalize partner bulletin + liability clause (owner)
- eng-release-bot/security: archive signature metadata & store in keyring (owner)
Due: partner requested deploy by 12:00 UTC tomorrow.

claire_m: Noted. Will create a short PR with the compat-image plan and label it "partner-1777-contingency".

partner-nre: Thanks team. We'll schedule the production window and notify our SI.

vikram: Great. If any regressions appear post-deploy we escalate per the runbook. Closing thread.
